proposition: Supplying a single controlled photograph (two or three frames at most), a short caption and a single wire will limit misreading by gossip columns; the Daily Mirror, The Times and small gossip sheets will respond differently and newsreels will pick up a neat frame if handed properly.
quote: "There are a few options," he said. "We ask her publicist for a controlled photograph—two or three frames at most—agree a short caption, and issue a single wire. It gives the papers something that can’t be misread in a gossip column. My worry is the columns: the Daily Mirror and The Times will print what they can, the small gossip sheets will make more than the facts. The newsreels will pick up a neat frame if we hand it to them properly."

proposition: Material decisions billed as official should be cleared by the Queen's Private Secretary; locally the liaison coordinates but escalates to Buckingham for official lines.
quote: "Ultimately, the Queen. Her Private Secretary would, in practice, clear anything billed as official. Locally I would coordinate; anything material goes up the chain."
